tasks.label: Build frontend with prefix
tasks.command: npm --prefix satellite-intelligence/frontend run build ; if ($?) { Write-Host 'BUILD_OK' } else { Write-Host 'BUILD_FAIL'; exit 1 }

tasks.label: Run backend tests
tasks.command: .\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q satellite-intelligence\backend ; if ($?) { Write-Host 'PYTEST_OK' } else { Write-Host 'PYTEST_FAIL'; exit 1 }

tasks.label: Backend pytest from backend dir
tasks.command: Set-Location 'satellite-intelligence\backend'; ..\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest -q ; if ($?) { Write-Host 'PYTEST_OK' } else { Write-Host 'PYTEST_FAIL'; exit 1 }

tasks.label: Backend pytest absolute path
tasks.command: & 'E:\project\Hackathon Erode\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -m pytest -q 'satellite-intelligence\backend' ; if ($?) { Write-Host 'PYTEST_OK' } else { Write-Host 'PYTEST_FAIL'; exit 1 }

tasks.label: Run backend tests in backend dir
tasks.command: Set-Location 'satellite-intelligence\backend'; & 'E:\project\Hackathon Erode\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -m pytest -q ; if ($?) { Write-Host 'PYTEST_OK' } else { Write-Host 'PYTEST_FAIL'; exit 1 }

tasks.label: Stop old backend server
tasks.command: $process = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'python.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'uvicorn main:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000' } ; if ($process) { Stop-Process -Id $process.ProcessId -Force; Write-Host 'STOPPED' } else { Write-Host 'NO_PROCESS' }

tasks.label: Verify pytest works from repo root
tasks.command: & 'E:\project\Hackathon Erode\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -m pytest -q 'satellite-intelligence\backend' ; if ($?) { Write-Host 'ROOT_PYTEST_OK' } else { Write-Host 'ROOT_PYTEST_FAIL'; exit 1 }

tasks.label: Compile backend and build frontend
tasks.command: & 'E:\project\Hackathon Erode\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -m compileall 'satellite-intelligence\backend'; npm --prefix 'satellite-intelligence/frontend' run build ; if ($?) { Write-Host 'VALIDATION_OK' } else { Write-Host 'VALIDATION_FAIL'; exit 1 }
